privacy.title: Help us make Tavlaki better
privacy.intro: We would like to collect anonymous usage data, for example:

collect.modes: which modes and games you play
collect.games: when a game starts and ends
collect.crashes: crash reports, so we can fix bugs

privacy.never: We never collect your name, email or contacts. Until you choose, we only send anonymous crash reports. "Don't allow" turns off usage data and crash reports. Change it any time in Settings.

botLevel.label: Bot level
botLevel.easyHint: Easy plays a random legal move. Good for learning.
botLevel.mediumHint: Medium plays like a casual player.
botLevel.hardHint: Hard plays like a strong player.
botLevel.soon: Medium and Hard are coming soon.

whoStarts.title: Who starts?
whoStarts.body: Each player rolls one die. High die starts.

rules.title: How to play {{game}}
rules.soon: The full rules page is coming soon.
rules.portes: Each player moves 15 checkers around the board and bears them off. The first to bear off all checkers wins: mono (1 point), or diplo (2 points) if the other player has borne off none.
